nativeModel: ProjectileWeaponComponent +4 rounds_per_minute: three f32 slots X/Y/Z. Y (+8) is the default and the only rate of a weapon without a ROF selector. With WeaponFunctionType ROF bound to an input, each press moves to the next slot (Y -> Z -> X), skipping 0.0 slots. Fixed storage: three rates at most.

states.selectable: The rate-of-fire selector is bound: every rate can be edited, added (up to three) or removed.
states.addable: No selector is bound but an input is free: rates beyond the default are written together with a weapon_function binding of "rate_of_fire" (one transaction).
states.single_rate: Both inputs are bound: only the default rate (one entry) can be edited.
states.absent: The weapon has no rate-of-fire slots.

modes.default: the first entry (native slot Y; also weapon.fire_rate)

binding.rule: bound in the same transaction as fire_rate.modes with 2+ rates

compatibility.weapon.fire_rate: unchanged: the default (Y) rate; it covers the same bytes, so it cannot be combined with fire_rate.modes in one plan

shareScope: weapon_local: every ProjectileWeaponComponentData and WeaponDataComponentData record has one owner.
addingModes: Three slots is the native storage; a fourth rate cannot exist. A zero slot is an absent mode that the selector skips, so adding a mode fills an empty slot of the weapon own record: no array grows, no record is reallocated and no neighbouring data is touched.
